organization_model.name: WHOLE_GRAMMAR_ORGANIZATION_MODEL_V2_CANDIDATE

ARCHETYPE_GRAMMAR.statement: An outerwear key is a composition of an ARCHETYPE relation (the short / long outerwear body — jacket and coat are separated by length) and a GRAMMAR relation (the tailored / casual / utility register that organizes that body). The archetype relation bears traceability; the grammar relation bears the organization ("Short / Long outerwear IN the <register> — the <register> grammar").

basis.quote: the reference is selected by archetype (+ grammar for outerwear), not by product category label
The jacket and coat categories are separated by length, so the coat domain begins where the jacket domain ends
Short outerwear in the casual register — the everyday non-tailored jacket grammar
Long outerwear in the tailored register — the tailored-coat grammar

CONJUNCTION.statement: A non-outerwear key names its archetype as a conjunction of identity constituents ("the X garment with Y and Z"); no frozen authority names a grammar / register relation distinct from the constituents (the trouser register is explicitly "a governed observation inside the one key, not a set of separate archetypes"; the sweatshirt "athletic origin" is provenance). Traceability and organization are therefore carried by the SAME relations — they are NOT SEPARABLE on frozen authority.

basis.quote: Its register — tailored, casual, sport, jeans, leggings — is a governed observation inside the one key, not a set of separate archetypes
`trouser_distinction` across its full governed range is register, not departure
The pulled-on jersey/fleece upper-body garment of athletic origin

ONE_PIECE_COMPOSITION.statement: A one-piece key names a JOINING relation (upper body joined to a lower body across a waist) organizing two body relations — a textually separable organization whose joining relation has no executable carrier (waist_definition is not projected).

basis.quote: The one-piece garment joining an upper body and a skirt body across a waist
It shares the one-piece composition principle with the dress but takes the trouser lower vocabulary

roles.ORGANIZING: the relation that organizes the archetype body into THIS grammar (outerwear: the register); its constituents are the register's named build elements

organization_model.organizing_relation_status_rule: ORGANIZING relation (register) over its constituents: PRESENT iff some executable constituent is RETAINED / SUBORDINATED · DISPLACED iff every constituent is executable and DISPLACED · UNRESOLVED otherwise (including: every executable constituent DISPLACED while some constituent is NOT_EXECUTABLE — fail closed). organization_model.whole_organization_reorganization_criter: F (outerwear keys): the original grammar is substantially dismantled / reorganized iff the ORGANIZING relation is DISPLACED while the TRACEABILITY-BEARING relation remains present (RETAINED / SUBORDINATED). E_local_reconstruction_tolerance.statement: Original organization principal while some register constituent still organizes: a re-proportioned lapel (Enlarged), a replaced lapel with the breasted front present, a replaced closure with the lapel present, a removed sleeve system, Oversized / Cropped body, power shoulder — all modifications of the tailored organization (the register is present while any constituent is present).

F_whole_organization_reorganization.criterion: Dismantled / reorganized iff the tailored register is DISPLACED (every constituent replaced) while the outerwear body remains. Because the structured-shoulder constituent is NOT_EXECUTABLE, the register can never read DISPLACED on current evidence: lapel + breasted front both DISPLACED → UNRESOLVED (fail closed).

suit_whole_unit.note: NO Suit key · NO Suit answer row (§18). Whole-Suit organization = P-3 composition of the JACKET:Tailored organization block and the trouser organization block.
suit_whole_unit.composition_rule: unit traceable iff every member traceable; unit original organization principal iff ANY member's original organization is principal (a member whose organization holds keeps the whole unit organized); unit primacy shift iff EVERY member reads primacy shift (one member never decides); a NOT_SEPARABLE member with a displaced identity constituent → unit UNRESOLVED

member_coordination.why: SUIT_COORDINATION_AUTHORITY_INSUFFICIENT — the frozen pair doctrine composes Direction only; no governed relation binds the members' organizations (matched cloth = context)

basis.quote: MATCHING_PAIR — ONE scoring unit, ONE TC Direction

suit_whole_unit.consequence: because the trouser member is NOT_SEPARABLE, a whole-Suit primacy shift is unreachable on current authority (a Suit can read ORIGINAL_ORGANIZATION_PRINCIPAL or UNRESOLVED, never TRACEABLE_RADICAL_REORGANIZATION)
